description: Test the frozen Kin LLM candidate only under a deterministic, recoverable subset of its own trigger, with a same-gate equal-character sham control. This does not reverse or pool with the prior continuous-R0 rejection.

gate.static_block_capacity: current block plus 0/1 knapsack over legal visible positive-block cards under current energy; no draw, energy generation, upgrades, Weak, or kill effects
gate.evidence_note: The literal trigger appears in source blocks 001 and 004, but only block 004 round 15 is recoverable by max visible block alone; recoverability is an identifiability filter, not a semantic rewrite of the candidate card.

invariants: Do not modify the frozen baseline or candidate card text.
B0 uses the existing unwrapped baseline run_arm implementation.
P1 and R1C share one deterministic gate implementation and differ only in payload semantics.
P1 and R1C add exactly the same number of rendered characters when delivered.
At most one payload is delivered per fight.
Run arms serially within each block and run blocks concurrently.
ITT over all valid complete blocks is the only promotion-driving analysis; delivered-only results are descriptive.
Zero or asymmetric delivery is reported as gate coverage, not silently excluded from ITT.
Do not pool screen with confirmation to make the confirmation gate pass.
